_description: SS income with 0% taxable fraction (low provisional income). Tests basic SS flow and that SS is untaxed when below threshold.
_rationale: Single filer, Florida (no state tax), $24k SS at age 62, haircut disabled. Provisional income = 0 + 0.5 * 24000 = $12,000, below $25k single threshold, so 0% of SS is taxable. No spending (startAge beyond lifeExpectancy). Balance grows by $24k/yr from age 62 onward.
name: SS Basic
